title: Add PR Pool confirmed ingest semantics
objective: Allow confirmed implementation proposals to enter PR Pool as ready requirement slices while Goal-generated proposals remain draft until user confirmation.
nonGoals: Do not embed full exploration transcripts in the PR item brief.
Do not create a CodeAgent task during ingest.
constraints: Goal-origin proposals default to confirmation required.
Only ready PR items may be consumed by PR Pool cron scan.
acceptanceCriteria: A confirmed proposal creates a ready PRItem.
A Goal proposal without confirmation creates a draft PRItem.
The PRItem preserves confirmation, nonGoals, constraints, and references metadata.
Dry-run validates without writing and reports the target status.
testCommand: npx vitest run tests/pr-pool-store.test.ts tests/pr-pool-runtime.test.ts tests/task-dispatcher.test.ts tests/pr-pool-ingest-cli.test.ts
codeAgentPrompt: Implement PR Pool confirmed ingest semantics from .omc/pr-pool-confirmed-ingest-requirements.md with code, docs, and tests kept in sync.
